title: Add multi select support for sprite frame animation actions

milestone.title: 4.x
milestone.description: Issues and pull requests slated for an undetermined Godot 4 release.

body:
## Proposal
https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14381

## Motivation

In the SpriteFrames window when managing sprite frames and animations for an AnimatedSprite2D, there is no way to perform multi select operations on the animations. Operations like copy, paste, cut, and delete all must be done individually.

I ran into this issue when re-designing a major workflow for my game, and had to one by one move over animations to a new scene. Having a multi-select version would have made that process a little less tedious.

This PR adds multi select support for each of those operations: you can now shift + click to select consecutive animations, or ctrl + click to individually select multiple animations. 

This PR also adds logic to support batch editing animation FPS and loop status. When multiple animations are selected, you can now edit the FPS and loop status for all selected animations.

## Changes

### editor/scene/sprite_frames_editor_plugin.h

- Define new class ClipboardAnimationMulti, which functions as a wrapper around the existing ClipboardAnimation. 
  - ClipboardAnimationMulti contains a list of ClipboardAnimation
- Update _animation_remove_undo_redo to accept new parameters
  - p_anims_to_delete
    - A list of animations to delete. This is needed to ensure that we dont accidentally try and load an animation that has been submitted for deletion. 
  - p_frames_map
    - A map of string to animation frames. For delete, this will be nullptr. For cut this will be a pre-read frame data needed for clipboard and undo restoration

### editor/scene/sprite_frames_editor_plugin.cpp

#### Copy

- Reworked the existing copy method `_animation_copy` to support ClipboardAnimationMulti 
- Sets the clipboard value to ClipboardAnimationMulti instead of the old ClipboardAnimation

#### Paste

- Reworked the existing copy method `_animation_paste` to support ClipboardAnimationMulti  
- Performs same operations as before except now on the entire ClipboardAnimationMulti list
- Note that the action name now reflects if there are more than 1 animation selected
```
String action_name = anims_to_paste.size() == 1
		? TTR("Paste Animation")
		: vformat(TTR("Paste %d Animations"), anims_to_paste.size())
```

#### Cut/Delete

- In `_animation_remove`, update the dialogue text to be based on the count of items to be deleted
  - 1 item : same text as old
  - >1 item: new text with count included
- In `_animation_remove_confirmed`, we perform a similar action name operation
  - Also pass the list of animations to be deleted to `_animation_remove_undo_redo`. 
- Update `_animation_cut` to support ClipboardAnimationMulti 
- `_animation_remove_undo_redo` is where the bulk of the cut/delete changes are
  - First, when finding the next animation, we use the `p_anims_to_delete` to ensure none of those are selected as the "next animation". 
  - Move the core logic into a loop to support multiple cut/deletion
  - Use the `p_frames_map` to ensure undo can be done for each batched animation
- Update `_find_next_animation_excluding` to ignore animations passed in through an exclude list


## Testing

### Current behavior 
This is on the 4.6 version(I am doing shift + click and ctrl + click in this video), but only one animation is being selected

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5216fdb1-3872-40af-81fd-7b990513996f

### New behavior (from my local build)
Tests done:
1) shift + click selects all animations between start + end
2) ctrl + click select multiple specific animations
3) you can copy multiple animations
4) you can paste all the animations from 3
5) you can cut multiple animations (they are deleted)
6) you can paste the animations from 5
7) you can ctrl + z to undo the operation in 6
8) you can delete multiple selected animations
9) you can ctrl + z to undo the operation in 8
10) when selecting multiple animations, you can update the FPS for all selections
11) when selecting multiple animations, you can update the loop status for all selections
